items.name: narration_en
items.direction: Narrate this as a high-energy geography countdown Short for BHUGOL, a popular geography fun-facts YouTube channel. The Narrator is SUPER excited and happy, practically bursting with energy: a hyped-up, thrilled YouTube host who loves catching people out with this quiz. Huge smile in the voice the whole way, bright, punchy and lively. Each 'Number five / four / three / two / one' is announced like a game-show reveal with rising hype, number one the biggest. Every 'Not Toronto... it's Ottawa' style line has a teasing beat on the wrong city and a triumphant, grinning hit on the right one. 'But number one is the weirdest' is leaned-in and conspiratorial. Bern's line is a grumpy, put-upon little voice. The last line trails off unfinished, voice staying up, so it loops straight back into the first line. Keep the dramatic pauses on the '...' marks short and punchy, never long. Never slow, flat, calm, sleepy or documentary-serious. VOICE IDENTITY: always the same warm baritone host, same person and same high energy throughout. Accent: native General American English narrator, neutral American accent from the first word to the last. Pronounce Canberra as CAN-bruh, Brasília as bra-ZEEL-ya, Abuja as ah-BOO-jah, Abu Dhabi as AH-boo DAH-bee, Bern as BURN, Zurich as ZOOR-ik, U A E as the letters U-A-E.
lines: Number five: Canada. Not Toronto... it's Ottawa.
Queen Victoria picked it in eighteen fifty-seven, right between English and French Canada.
Number four: Australia. Not Sydney... it's Canberra.
Sydney and Melbourne both wanted it... so they built a new city in between.
And the next country did it even faster.
Number three: Brazil. Not Rio... it's Brasília.
Built in the middle of nowhere in about four years, capital since nineteen sixty.
Number two: Nigeria. Not Lagos... it's Abuja.
A brand-new city in the middle, capital since nineteen ninety-one.
But number one is the weirdest.
Number one: Switzerland. Zurich? Geneva? Nope... Bern.
Except... officially, Switzerland has no capital at all!
Bern is just the federal city.
Bern: I do all the work... and I'm not even official!
